adjudication.rationale: The diff shows TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` (lib/topic_retriever.rb) when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true. PollFeed is implemented as `Jobs::Scheduled` with `recurrence { hourly }`, so invoking it directly from a per-request/embed retrieval path tightly couples TopicRetriever to the scheduled job’s implementation and runs the whole feed polling synchronously just to satisfy a single embed URL check. This is a concrete architecture/scope concern introduced by the change, not a directly provable functional defect.
